Demi Lovato tied the knot with singer-songwriter Jordan "Jutes" Lutes in a sweet ceremony in Santa Barbara on Sunday. 🤍 💍

Demi walked down the aisle in a couture Vivienne Westwood dress, and had multiple outfit changes throughout the night.

The couple, who met collaborating on her music, first went public with their romance in August 2022. | Entertainment Tonight | Facebook
